g.text: Selected inflammatory RNA targets: four separate deposited contrasts
Primary: all deposited positive-RNA barcodes; pooled CPM over all source RNA genes
Finite-library descriptions; no population inference or state attribution. GSE329778 contrasts reuse CTRL.
A transformed-expression difference is not an unqualified fold change; source sorting/genotype disagreements remain.
